subject: Priority SLA offer, credit request, and amendment for OptiBank
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@optibank.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: OptiBank Ops <ops@optibank.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Repeated latency spikes this week — impact to customer-facing flows

Sean,

We're seeing repeated 2-3s latency spikes and several token-generation timeouts on our production inference calls between 11/25–11/28. This has caused retries and slow page loads for several of our customers during peak trading hours. We attached a quick export from our observability pipeline that highlights the spikes (latency_report_nov2026.csv).

Can you confirm:
- What root cause analysis you can share quickly?
- Whether this qualifies for an SLA credit?
- Our options for moving to a higher priority SLA to avoid future customer impact (I'm particularly interested in assured SSE/throughput during peak windows).

OptiBank would like a short call this week to triage; CCing our ops lead.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Platform Reliability
OptiBank
[Attachment: latency_report_nov2026.csv (csv)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@optibank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Repeated latency spikes this week — impact to customer-facing flows

Samira — thanks for the report and the CSV. First, I'm really sorry for the customer impact: this is not the experience we expect for production workloads.

Immediate steps we've taken:
- Opened a priority incident with infra (ticket INF-7832) and capturing KV cache heatmaps for the windows you flagged.
- Raised a temporary routing policy to route OptiBank traffic to our US-west low-latency pool while we stabilize.

Commercial/longer-term options:
- We can offer a migration to our Priority SLA tier (guaranteed higher reserved capacity and defined latency SLOs during specified peak windows) plus a 1.5x token burst buffer for the first 30 days. I've attached the Priority SLA overview and the commercial terms we typically use.
- Preliminary credit: based on the reports you shared, we propose a one-time service credit equivalent to one week of committed usage while we complete the RCA. If you'd like a formal legal amendment, we can draft one for signature.

If you approve, I'll loop in our Renewal & Contracts team to produce an amendment and run the DocuSign flow. Also proposing a 30-minute triage call tomorrow to walk through the RCA we have so far.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_priority_sla_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@optibank.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Commercial terms for Priority SLA + proposed amendment

Samira / Sean — looping in commercial for the high-level terms so OptiBank can review before legal.

Summary of proposal:
- Priority SLA: +28% on current committed monthly fee (applies to the committed capacity portion), includes reserved GPUs during OptiBank peak windows (08:00–12:00 PT).
- Onboarding: 3 business-day upgrade window once amendment is signed; optional technical verification call included.
- One-time service credit: equal to 7 days of committed usage (applied to the first invoice after amendment).

Attached is the draft amendment (optibank_amendment_draft.docx) with redlines for the SLA section and the credit clause. If this meets expectations, we can route to legal and procurement for signatures; if OptiBank needs changes to the uptime/latency buckets we can fine-tune.

Action items:
1) Samira to confirm acceptance of commercial uplift + credit clause
2) OptiBank procurement to send PO or preferred bill-to details
3) Upon signature, infra will schedule the upgrade (3 business days).

Marissa Cole
Director, Renewals & Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: optibank_amendment_draft.docx (docx)]

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.khan@optibank.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commercial terms for Priority SLA + proposed amendment

Quick technical note from infra:
- Preliminary RCA points to KV-cache eviction storms during the high concurrency bursts your traffic pattern shows; we see mem churn in the US-west pool on 11/26–11/28 between 08:30–10:15 PT.
- Temporary mitigation (already applied by Sean): pinning OptiBank to a reserved low-latency pool reduces observed p95 by ~40% in our internal test.

What we need from OptiBank ops to finalize the fix:
- Traces for a representative request (span-level trace or the full request id). If you can't share traces, we can accept anonymized token-level timing windows.
- Confirmation of peak window times/days for the amendment so we don't over-provision outside your SLA window.

If you approve the Priority upgrade we'll:
- Provision a dedicated capacity slice for your tenant and enable eviction isolation (no noisy-neighbor churn).
- Run a two-day verification period and share telemetry dashboards.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Staff SRE, Runtime
Redwood Inference

> On Sun, 29 Nov 2026 at 11:03, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Samira — thanks for the report and the CSV. First, I'm really sorry for the customer impact...
> > [Attachment: redwood_priority_sla_v1.pdf]

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@optibank.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: OptiBank Procurement <procurement@optibank.com>, Ops <ops@optibank.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commercial terms for Priority SLA + proposed amendment

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We appreciate the temporary routing and the clear remediation plan. OptiBank is prepared to accept the Priority SLA upgrade and the one-week credit, subject to a couple of clarifications before we sign:
- Please add a clause that credits are applied pro-rata if the billed month is partial.
- Can you confirm the exact start date for the 3 business-day upgrade window (we'd like the change to begin no earlier than Dec 6 to align with a campaign freeze).

Procurement, can you please share PO instructions or preferred billing contact so Redwood can issue the amendment?

Samira
Head of Platform Reliability
OptiBank

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@optibank.com>, OptiBank Procurement <procurement@optibank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commercial terms for Priority SLA + proposed amendment

Samira — great, thanks for the prompt confirmation and clear asks.

Responses to your clarifications:
- We'll add a pro-rata credit clause to the amendment.
- Start date confirmed: upgrade will be scheduled to begin on Dec 6 (3 business-day window after signature, we'll hold to your campaign freeze).

Next steps:
1) I'll route the redlined amendment to Redwood Legal for final review and then generate a DocuSign envelope (anticipated today). DocuSign link: https://docusign.net/OptiBank-Amendment
2) Procurement to send PO or billing contact; once DocuSign is signed, infra will lock in the reserved capacity and start the two-day verification run.
3) I'll set up a verification call with Dylan and your ops team on Dec 8 to review telemetry and confirm p95 targets.

Thanks again for working through this with us — we want to make sure OptiBank has predictable performance and clear remedies if things go sideways.

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
[Related HubSpot: https://redwood.app/hubspot/deal/DEAL-8421]
